summary.en: LASSO, adaptive LASSO and correlation-weighted elastic-net estimators for dispersed count data with multicollinear and high-dimensional predictors, published in 2026 with an openly licensed (CC BY 4.0) supplementary dataset.

An Arabic-language community for statistics education on Facebook, Telegram and WhatsApp, founded to make advanced statistics accessible across the Arab world. The Telegram group had 46,523 members on 5 November 2026.

Self-published guides on regression and econometric methods, shared on ResearchGate: ridge regression, the ARDL bounds testing approach, sample size calculation, and a regression handbook covering more than 250 models.
